description: A dedicated ephemeral ZenX browser session with bounded DOM inspection and narrow navigation and interaction tools.

permissions.title: Inspect browser tabs
permissions.description: List tabs, inspect visible text and targets, and explicitly read full page content, screenshots, network events/responses and console diagnostics.

permissions.title: Open and navigate pages
permissions.description: Open URLs or navigate an explicitly targeted ZenX browser tab.

permissions.title: Interact with pages
permissions.description: Interact with the exact observed tab through element, coordinate/key input or programmable JavaScript; JavaScript may mutate the page, submit forms or send requests.

tools.name: browser_list_tabs
tools.description: List bounded metadata for tabs in one explicit ZenX browser session. Cookies, storage, headers, and history are never returned.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open an http(s) URL in a hidden tab in an explicit ephemeral ZenX browser session. Returns the new tabId without activating an app window.

keep.description: Keep this new page as a deliverable after the turn; defaults to false.

observe.description: Return a fresh observation after the action; defaults to true. Set false to skip the read. A failed follow-up read never retries the completed action.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate one explicit ZenX browser session/tab target to an http(s) URL.

observationId.description: Required for a shared Workspace tab after human takeover: pass its latest browser_inspect observationId. Missing, stale, or pre-takeover references reject. Other backends do not require this field.

tools.name: browser_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one tab, or use nextCursor to read more of its exact captured snapshot. Coverage distinguishes unread captured data from native omissions. Omit baseObservationId or set full:true for a self-contained first page; a retained matching base allows a smaller diff. Target IDs are stable only for surviving observed DOM nodes; actions require the fresh observationId.

cursor.description: Continue the exact immutable captured observation using its returned nextCursor. Does not recapture or renew action references. Omit to inspect afresh.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

query.description: Search role, name, and value within this backend's captured targets. Coverage names the capture scope; a miss is not a whole-page claim. Follow nextCursor for more matches from the same capture.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click one visible, clickable opaque target from the latest browser_inspect observation. Stale, forged, hidden, or changed targets fail closed.

observe.description: Return a fresh observation after the action; defaults to true. Set false to skip the read. A failed follow-up read never retries the completed action.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: browser_pointer_click
tools.description: Click CSS viewport coordinates in the exact observed browser tab without requesting window activation. Requires a real screenshot and inputViewport from the latest inspection. Convert screenshot pixels with x * inputViewport.width / screenshot.width and likewise y. No frames, dragging, OS input or automatic foreground fallback. Detected page, viewport, focus, or user input changes reject. Open shadow roots resolve within bounded limits; ordinary div/span containers remain supported after exact-node metadata checks, while known closed or unresolved shadow surfaces reject locally. Ordinary tab input stays targeted without selecting an active tab. Trusted input can trigger site dialogs or popups; identifiable native pickers reject and native UI requires human control, never global input or forced activation. Unknown input is never replayed.

tools.name: browser_key_press
tools.description: Press one named unmodified key in the exact browser tab's already-focused observed element, without requesting window activation. Requires focusedInputAvailable and a fresh inspection; never selects a current tab or focuses an element implicitly. Open shadow focus resolves to its real node; ordinary focused contenteditable containers remain supported after exact-node metadata checks, while known closed or unresolved shadow focus is unavailable. Ordinary tab input stays targeted without selecting an active tab. Trusted input can trigger site dialogs or popups; identifiable native pickers reject and native UI requires human control, never global input or forced activation. Unknown input is never replayed.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Replace the value in one visible, typeable opaque target from the latest browser_inspect observation, optionally submitting its form. Text is dispatched as an ordinary tool argument regardless of field metadata.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Select one native option by exact value or unique exact visible label in a visible select target from the latest browser_inspect observation. Consumes the observation and fails closed if the target or option changed.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page viewport in one explicit tab using the latest browser_inspect observation. Direction is up/down/left/right and pixels is an integer from 1 to 2000. Consumes the observation; inspect again before interacting. Nested scrolling containers are not supported.

observe.description: Return a fresh observation after the action; defaults to true. Set false to skip the read. A failed follow-up read never retries the completed action.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close one explicit ZenX browser tab and invalidate its latest observation.

observationId.description: Required for a shared Workspace tab after human takeover: pass its latest browser_inspect observationId. Missing, stale, or pre-takeover references reject. Other backends do not require this field.

tools.name: browser_close_session
tools.description: Close every hidden tab in one explicit ZenX browser session, clear its storage/cache, and ensure reopening the same sessionId uses a fresh partition.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in a separate page DOM isolated world. May mutate pages, submit forms or send requests; requires a fresh observation and interaction permission. Defaults to a separate isolated world; world:main selects the pinned page context to access application globals.

tools.name: browser_network_start
tools.description: Start opt-in network event collection on the exact tab attachment; survives fresh code calls, no past traffic recovery.

tools.name: browser_network_read
tools.description: Read bounded captured network events using eventCursor and limit (1–100). Full retained capture is in ephemeral rawPath; evicted cursors fail.

tools.name: browser_network_response
tools.description: Read body and base64Encoded for an observed requestId in this exact attachment. Native response eviction is an error.

tools.name: browser_console_start
tools.description: Start opt-in console/error collection on the exact tab attachment; survives fresh code calls.

tools.name: browser_console_read
tools.description: Read bounded console events with eventCursor and limit (1–100), plus ephemeral full rawPath.

tools.name: browser_content
tools.description: Read full current top-document HTML from the exact owned tab.

tools.name: browser_extensions
tools.description: List extensions actually implemented by this tab's provider; unsupported backends never fall back.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the exact tab with existing fenced inspect and return PNG artifact plus fresh observation.

name: Browser
mainDocument: For a new browsing task, prefer open to create a background task page; use an existing tab when the user's task calls for that page. New connected pages are grouped by task session automatically. New pages are temporary and close at turn/session end unless open uses keep:true for a deliverable; existing user pages are released. The Host displays the exact operated page automatically, without model UI commands. Browser actions observe by default with a small backend-captured subset and use exact backend-scoped refs. Use full:true for a broader self-contained capture. Inspect returns a bounded capture; query searches captured targets only, and cursor reads its immutable continuation. Pass since with a retained observation ref for a diff, or full:true after context loss. Every new observation has new action refs; diff targetChanges.replacements maps old refs to fresh refs. Discard prior continuation pages on every new observation or first-page diff and follow its new nextCursor for tails. Human takeover blocks Workspace mutations until the user returns control and a fresh inspection is made. If actionCompleted has observationError, inspect again without repeating the action. Unknown effects must not be replayed. Connected browsers require explicit connection discovery and approval; they never fall back to Workspace.
